departments.name: Cardiology
departments.description: Interventional cardiology, echocardiography, arrhythmia clinics, and preventive heart care.

departments.name: Neurology
departments.description: Stroke rapid response, epilepsy management, neuromuscular disorders, and cognitive neurology.

departments.name: Orthopedics
departments.description: Minimally invasive joint replacement, spine surgery, arthroscopy, and sports injury rehabilitation.

departments.name: Pediatrics
departments.description: Neonatology, childhood immunizations, developmental pediatrics, and adolescent wellness.

departments.name: Dermatology
departments.description: Clinical dermatology, dermatosurgery, pediatric skin disorders, and hair restoration therapy.

doctors.name: Dr. Arvind Subramanian
doctors.bio: Leads complex coronary angioplasty and preventive lipid management clinics with 16 years of tertiary cardiac experience.

doctors.name: Dr. Meenakshi Nair
doctors.bio: Specializes in 3D stress echocardiography, women’s cardiovascular health, and longitudinal heart failure recovery.

doctors.name: Dr. Karthikeyan Venkataraman
doctors.bio: Chief Neurologist overseeing acute stroke protocols, movement disorder clinics, and migraine precision therapy.

doctors.name: Dr. Lakshmi Narayanan
doctors.bio: Focused on refractory epilepsy diagnostics, EEG telemetry interpretation, and peripheral neuropathy care.

doctors.name: Dr. Senthil Balasubramanian
doctors.bio: Performs robotic-assisted knee and hip arthroplasty alongside minimally invasive lumbar spine decompression.

doctors.name: Dr. Anitha Rajagopalan
doctors.bio: Treats ACL ligament reconstructions, rotator cuff injuries, and structured athletic return-to-play programs.

doctors.name: Dr. Raghavan Krishnamurthy
doctors.bio: Nearly two decades guiding newborn intensive follow-up, immunization schedules, and childhood respiratory health.

doctors.name: Dr. Divya Padmanabhan
doctors.bio: Dedicated to childhood asthma management, food allergy immunotherapy, and adolescent nutrition.

doctors.name: Dr. Vijayalakshmi Natarajan
doctors.bio: Expertise in autoimmune skin conditions, dermoscopy screening, and scar revision procedures.

doctors.name: Dr. Harishankar Menon
doctors.bio: Focuses on eczema management, alopecia diagnostics, and evidence-based phototherapy protocols.
